images.caption:
Blue plaque on the southern wall bordering the Creamery House in Castlecomer.
"This house was originally built and later reconstructed by Robert Kane after the 1798 rebellion. It was previously home to the Castlecomer Perambulator and Basket factory and later provided accommodation and offices for the Castlecomer Co-Operative Creamery, in the 20th Century. After recent restoration, the building now houses office accommodation and the Lady Anne Restaurant."
images.alt:
Blue plaque on the southern wall bordering the Creamery House in Castlecomer.

images.filename: Castles of Leinster, Ballyragget, Kilkenny - geograph.org.uk - 1393576.jpg
images.caption: Castles of Leinster: Ballyragget, Kilkenny Built in 1495 by the Mountgarret family, Ballyragget Castle was garrisoned in 1600 by Sir George Carew against the sons of the owner Lord Mountgarret, who were in rebellion against the crown. It had at one time also been a favourite residence of the celebrated Lady Margaret Fitzgerald, Countess of Ormonde.
